name: year
description: Year the population is projected for, at 30 June

name: projection_base_year
description: Year of the estimated resident population the projection is based on
observations: 2022 for the current release; ABS re-bases the projections every few years

name: series
description: Projection series, high, medium or low
observations: ABS series 1(A) high, 29(B) medium and 45(C) low, which differ in their assumed fertility, life expectancy, net overseas migration and interstate migration. The medium series is the one ABS describes as the most likely

name: geography_level
description: Geographic level of the row, either state or australia
observations: australia marks the national aggregate, which is not a state and therefore carries a null state_id; state marks one of the eight states and territories

name: state_id
description: Code of the Australian state or territory
observations: Null on national (australia) rows, which are not a state

name: region_name
description: Name of the state, territory or national aggregate as published by the ABS

name: sex
observations: Male, Female or Persons, where Persons is the ABS-published total

name: age
description: Single year of age of the projected population
observations: Single years 0 to 84 plus 85 and over for the states, and 0 to 99 plus 100 and over for Australia; stored as a string because the top group is not a number

name: series_id
description: ABS series identifier of the projected series
observations: Foreign key to the au_abs_population series table
